parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays where the assay organism is human and the target is the Niemann-Pick C1 intracellular cholesterol transporter 1 (CHEMBL1293277). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target ChEMBL ID and assay organism. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Alias the molecule identifier as compound_chembl_id. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
